title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
description: Lists a wholly disproportionate penalty on a consumer as one feature of an unfair contract.
relevance: Possible reference point when a contract imposes a large cancellation or breach penalty. Applicability depends on the full agreement and facts.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
description: Includes an unreasonable charge, obligation, or condition that puts a consumer at a disadvantage in the definition of an unfair contract.
relevance: Possible reference point when reviewing an additional charge. The tool does not determine whether a specific charge is unreasonable.
